Name: Red's Penny For Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
Author: mxrcherr
Description:
I love both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/860]magimatica's Penny design[/url]﻿﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]seasonal cute characters [/url]and merged them together with some edits for my own file a while ago, and figured someone else might enjoy them so I've decided to upload them here! :)

[size=2]This is my first real project editing any kind of pixel art so If there are any inconsistencies/errors I've missed please let me know! [/size]
[b][size=3]
[/size][/b]**Penny's nose files for her sprites in seasonal cute outfits, and the winter outdoor, jellies, flower dance, and summer sprites are not included with this mod bc I didn't change them at all, and the freckle file in portraits is a blank png just to avoid any errors for file not found in SMAPI. [size=2](I'm unsure if that was necessary though, so delete the freckle file if you want!)[/size][b][size=2]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][center][/center][/b][left][b]THIS IS NOT A FUNCTIONAL MOD ON ITS OWN! ONLY CONTAINS IMAGE FILES!! [/b]
This was formatted to be used to replace Penny's files within [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] for 1.6. Use for another portrait mod if you wish[size=2] (**note the missing sprites)[/size][/left][size=2]
[/size][size=3][b]
[/b][/size][center][b][size=3]CREDITS! THIS IS NOT MY ART!! [/size][size=2]
All art used belongs to: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/magimatica?gameId=1303]magimatica[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/IronZelly?gameId=1303]IronZelly[/url][/size][/b][size=2] , <333 Thank you all sm !!
[/size][/center][size=2]
[/size]
[size=4][b]INSTALLATION FOR SEASONAL CUTE OUTFITS:
[/b][/size]1. Download and extract [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] if you don't already have it.
2. Download and extract this mod
3. Open up the [u]Red's Penny for Seasonal Cute Outfits[/u] folder from this mod until you see a folder named [u]assets[/u] inside. Don't open anything else.
4. In a new File Explorer window (or whatever file manager you use), open up the [b][size=2]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/size] [/b]mod folder until you also see the [b]assets[/b] folder (inside[size=2] [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters[/b][/size]) Don't open anything else.
5. MOVE the [u]assets[/u] folder from this mod INTO [b][size=2][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters[/size][/b], NOT INSIDE THE ASSETS FOLDER
6. Click yes to [i]replace all files [/i][i]in this destination[/i][u][i]
[/i][/u]7. Move the[b][size=2] [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters [/size][/b]folder into your mods folder if it isn't there already[u][i]

[/i][/u]Enjoy![size=2] (I tried my best with the instructions so please let me know if you need clarity or any help!)[/size]
